'''Paddy Accu''' was an elderly [[Gender|male]] [[human]] who lived on the [[planet]] [[Naboo]] shortly before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars]]. He worked as the caretaker of [[Varykino]], an island retreat owned by the [[Naberrie family]] in the [[Lake Country]] area of Naboo.<ref name="USW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref> When [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]]—[[senator]] for Naboo and a member of the Naberrie family—went into hiding after a series of [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala|attempts on her life]], Accu transported her and the [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] to Varykino in a [[Berenko-class speeder|gondola speeder]].<ref name="AOTC" /> Accu had worked there since Amidala's childhood.<ref name="Altaya">{{EncyclopediaCite|Naboo}}</ref> Upon reaching the villa he helped unpack the pairs' bags from the boat. Accu had fair skin and [[Color|gray]] [[hair]].<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The caretaker here is Paddy Accu, named in the script. He was gonna be the gondola driver, but I doubt you could fit three comfortably in this.|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|<ref name="Paddy Accu tweet" />}}
Paddy Accu first appeared in the now-[[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] by [[R. A. Salvatore]] which was released in [[2002]]<ref name="AOCn">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref> shortly before the film itself, which Accu also briefly appeared in played by an uncredited extra.<ref name="AOTC" /> The character's name was confirmed to be [[canon]] in the reference book ''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'', which was released in [[2015]].<ref name="USW" />
